title: Living Birds
subtitle: Living Birds is a fully automated collection of realistic birds for any game
description:
Living Birds is a fully automated collection of realistic birds for any game. In less than a minute you can have singing, animated and fully AI driven birds in your game. Each bird is under 730 tris and includes 2 songs unique to its species. The system dynamically updates bird targets, spawning, unspawning, and all bird actions so you don't have to worry about anything.

NOW INCLUDING CROWS!


Features:
-AI driven realistic birds
-New collision avoidence system
-7 species, 14 unique birdsongs
-Pause independent of Time.timeScale
-dynamic bird target loading/unloading
-730 triangle models

title: Toucan
subtitle: 3D Toucan Bird with Flying Animation
description:
Bring a vibrant tropical touch to your 3D environments with this animated Toucan Bird model, designed for games, wildlife scenes, and nature-themed projects.

This 3D Toucan features a distinctive large yellow-orange beak with a dark tip, a black feathered body, a white chest, and textured wings. Its colorful appearance makes it a recognizable addition to tropical forests, jungle environments, and outdoor scenes.

The model includes a flying animation featuring wing-flapping movement, allowing the bird to be used in animated flight sequences and environmental wildlife scenes.

Key Features:

Textured 3D Toucan Bird model

Large yellow-orange beak with dark detailing

Black body with contrasting white chest

Textured wings and tail

1 Flying Animation (Fly)

Suitable for games and 3D animation projects

Perfect For:

Tropical and jungle environments

Wildlife and bird simulation games

Adventure and exploration games

Nature-themed animations

Outdoor environmental scenes

Whether you're creating a tropical jungle, wildlife simulation, or animated nature environment, this Toucan Bird can add color, movement, and life to your project.

title: 6 Fish Pack
subtitle: 6 Animated Tropical Fish 3D Models
description:
Bring your underwater environments to life with this Animated Fish Pack, featuring six colorful and uniquely designed 3D fish models with multiple animation clips.

Each fish has its own distinctive appearance, featuring vibrant colors, detailed body patterns, textured fins, and realistic aquatic shapes. From bright yellow tropical fish to beautifully patterned reef fish, this collection adds visual variety to underwater scenes, ocean environments, and aquatic simulations.

The pack includes swimming and movement animations to help create lively underwater environments. Whether you're developing an underwater exploration game, an aquarium simulation, or a marine wildlife scene, these fish models can bring movement and diversity to your project.
